## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.6.1.4.1 (5.6.1.4 in Rel-15) Uplink data status a) (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: 5.6.1.4 is split and the text moves to 5.6.1.4.1; the condition adds "and the UE is: a) not in NB-N1 mode; or b) in NB-N1 mode and ..." before "the AMF shall:"; item a) is unchanged in every version)
- TS 24.501 5.6.1.5 first sentence (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: V15.0.0 and V15.7.0 end "and stop timer T3517"; absent by V16.15.0)
- TS 23.502 4.2.3.2 steps 12 and 18a (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "forwarded to RAN and UE" in step 18a; "NG-RAN and UE" by V15.17.0, unchanged through V19.9.0; the N2 Request's content in step 12 grows in every release, "N2 SM information received from SMF" and "MM NAS Service Accept" stay)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-SERVICE-REQUEST-REACTIVATES.md).
